core_claim: g4变胞移动Bragg峰位，但对现有Tashiro已索引d值的描述性偏差增大；不据此判断实验全谱强度拟合。

evidence.main_left: same-wavelength frozen-geometry simulated profiles plus published position ticks

export.editable_text: SVG text and PDF TrueType; separate native-label JSON

risks: Published d values are processed fiber-diffraction positions, not a continuous measured powder trace.
Observed measurement temperature is not established.
Fixed cell already uses experimental lattice parameters, so its smaller d error is not independent validation of atomic coordinates.
Each simulated profile normalized to its own max=100; no absolute intensity comparison.
Same-method numerical densification is separate from completed structural and cold-electronic acceptance.
